findings.F1: The tested effect is near zero and buried in noise: the pooled slope of excess 10-bar return on the forecast is 0.000202 (t 0.37, 1657 blocks); among the 832 active blocks alone it is 0.000341 (t 0.37); and up-spread blocks average only +0.00053 excess against -0.00054 for down-spread blocks (t 0.09 and -0.11).
findings.F2: The market's own moves dominate each coin's 10-bar return. The equal-weight cross-coin move explains 57% of its variance (R² 0.573). Once that move is removed, the slope falls to -0.000010 (t -0.03), or -0.000111 (t -0.17) on active blocks only.
findings.F3: Demeaned within each window instead of per coin, the slope turns clearly negative at -0.00163 (t -3.08). Most window slopes are negative, for example w16 at -0.0220 (t -5.73), w18 at -0.0106 (t -3.22) and w1 at -0.0163 (t -2.66), and the 2020 and 2022 slopes are also negative (t -2.22 and -2.42). The flat pooled slope therefore comes from active periods coinciding with strong market periods, not from the forecast ranking returns within a period.

findings.F7: Coins split by sign with no coin significant. Active minus flat mean excess is +0.0140 for ETH, +0.0128 for ZEC and +0.0056 for BTC, but -0.0157 for LTC, -0.0087 for XRP and -0.0022 for XMR. Per-coin slopes range from t -0.28 (XRP) to t 0.94 (BTC).
findings.F8: By raw 50/200 spread among up-spread blocks, the two smallest quintiles earn +0.0054 and +0.0085 excess and the largest quintile -0.0073, all with |t| < 0.71. The share of positive returns while active is 2.1 points below each coin's base rate (-0.0214).

ideas.idea: When a coin's 50-day SMA stands far above its 200-day SMA, in the top band of its own recent spread history, the coin's next 10 bars rise less than its typical 10-bar move over the same period. The stretched up-trend gives back ground rather than extending.
ideas.consequence: A trader should refuse or shrink long entries when the up-spread is unusually wide.
ideas.name: stretched spread underperforms

ideas.idea: When a coin's 50-day SMA has only recently moved above its 200-day SMA and the spread is still small, the coin's next 10 bars rise more than its typical 10-bar move.
ideas.consequence: A trader would concentrate long exposure on young, narrow golden crosses and not on mature, wide ones.
ideas.name: fresh narrow cross drifts
